title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
summary: Anthropic公布Claude Sheets、Whiteboards、Data及互动连接器，将对话中的数据处理、协作和企业应用连接放进同一个工作界面。TechCrunch报道白板和表格在付费方案上进入测试；官方页面把Claude Meetings列为即将推出，不能写成全面可用。对企业客户，值得看的是跨应用
investorNote: 对企业客户，值得看的是跨应用上下文和可审计操作是否真的减少人工搬运，而非把多种生成能力简单装在同一个入口。

evidence.quote: Anthropic announced new workplace features on Tuesday, including Claude Meetings, which brings Claude into video calls to begin working on tasks while participants are still talking.
Claude Whiteboards is available in beta on paid plans, on web, desktop, and mobile.
The company also launched Claude Sheets, which lets teams create and collaboratively edit spreadsheets with Claude.
